Author: Anomek
Name: AnoMech (Preview)
Description: Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. This build adds the DMU P5 Celestriad scenario (anomek/AnoMech#21) and a consecutive-success mechanic streak with optional auto-restart (anomek/AnoMech#22) ahead of them merging upstream; switch back to the official repo once those PRs land.
Punchline: Another FFXIV mechanics simulator, with the Celestriad and mechanic-streak previews.
